factor: Each candidate changes one admission rule relative to the common development-selected exit and 12-slot unlevered account. Baseline fallback is the untargeted cloud exit if no exit candidate meets all development gates. Entries retain original V1.7 week locking even when an admission is rejected. No stacked filters or symbol picks.

definitions.relative_strength_positive: side-adjusted prior 14-bar return minus BTC return > 0; pre-key closes
definitions.tight_reclaim: signal close within half the reference stop distance of touched extension (close_distance_r <=0.5)
definitions.same_side_stoch: V1.7 same-side Stoch event on the confirmed key
definitions.large_wick: touched-side wick >= one half of the key candle range
definitions.wide_monday: Monday width >=5 percent, in source percent units
definitions.strong_cloud: absolute confirmed EMA spread >=1 ATR per source
definitions.prior_market_breadth: at least 5 original same-side V1.7 signals on this 12H close across the available cohort, measured after confirmation and before opening orders

decision: Development-only rank absolute funded growth among candidates meeting unchanged 35% DD upper bound, >=30% wins, >=2.5 equal-notional payoff, >=100 closed development trades (minimum declared for this screen). Later years, original unfiltered comparator, survival universe and search multiplicity disclosed. No retuning from later results. Per-parent matched controls benchmark the picked event set.
